name: radio-group-37
description: Support ticket priority selector with colored severity dots.

files.content:
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem, } from "@workspace/ui/components/radio-group" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const priorities = [ { value: "low", label: "Low", dot: "bg-muted-foreground" }, { value: "medium", label: "Medium", dot: "bg-sky-500" }, { value: "high", label: "High", dot: "bg-amber-500" }, { value: "urgent", label: "Urgent", dot: "bg-destructive" }, ] export default function TicketPriorityPicker() { return (
Priority {priorities.map((p) => ( {p.label} ))} Urgent tickets page the on-call engineer.
) }
